title: Phage Functional Protein Candidate Database v1.0（噬菌体功能蛋白候选数据库 v1.0）
description: A prediction-level candidate database of phage functional proteins (depolymerases, endolysins, holins) with 4,117 candidates ranked by a six-dimension scoring scheme. Fields include functional annotation evidence (InterPro/Pfam/CDD/CAZy layer), structural evidence (AFDB homology, pLDDT, pocket features), host and genome classification, in silico substrate inference (non-definitive), and novelty/transferability scores. See README.md for the schema and reproduction queries.
